$comment: Held-out labelled benchmark for the demographic-anchoring probe v2 (src/domain/fairness-v2.ts). Written 2026-09-29 BEFORE the probe was run on it, after v2 had been tuned on the original 110-item set (tests/fixtures/fairness-benchmark.json), which is therefore a development set for v2. All text is synthetic, generic, AI-report style; no real patient data. expected = does the passage use a demographic or social attribute as diagnostic justification? Categories as in the original set; attribute gives the attribute class the item exercises. Implicit items deliberately use proxies that are in NO term list, to measure the probe's blind spot. Do not tune the probe on this file; add a new held-out file instead.
